title: Proof-owning stage re-derivation for MD-B01 required rules
attempt_outcome: PARTIAL — MD-B01 ownership re-derived; stage and MD-DEP-0004 remain open

runtime_artifact_boundary.classification: Section 5: traceability predicate classification/ownership analysis that does not claim runtime proof.
runtime_artifact_boundary.basis: This attempt claims no executed runtime proof. No acceptance criterion in its scope contains an executed proof obligation, so section 4 is not triggered and a storage scan is neither required nor performed.

defect_measured.measurement: All 91 strategy documents map to exactly one primary_stage; zero documents map to more than one.
defect_measured.conclusion: primary_stage is a pure function of the extraction document with no per-rule differentiation, which is what section 4 forbids. For single-purpose owner contracts the result is coincidentally correct; the defect concentrates in cross-cutting documents, of which MD-B01 holds the principal three.

method_rejected.what: A keyword classifier mapping rule text to build-sequence contract areas.
method_rejected.result: 41 proposed moves; roughly a third wrong on inspection.
examples_of_error: MD-S020-R0003 (boundary ownership statement) pulled to MD-B17 on the words "read model"
MD-S020-R0139 (upstream-neutral naming rule) pulled to MD-B17 on "read-product"
MD-S056-R0016 (Weekly Swing decision horizon, core MD-B01 scope) pulled to MD-B17 on "consumer"
MD-S020-R0107 (market-data replay must never be described as proof a strategy works — a boundary rule) pulled to MD-B18 on "replay"
MD-S056-R0093 and MD-S056-R0127 would have been moved despite already holding valid current proof
method_rejected.decision: Rejected and not applied. Substituting a pattern for the judgement section 4 requires is the same class of defect this dependency exists to correct.

method_applied.what: Explicit 15-entry table, each rule read in full and justified individually. No pattern matching in the applier.
method_applied.structural_refusals: The applier refuses to move any row that is SATISFIED, is not currently MD-B01, or is not REQUIRED. Zero refusals triggered, confirming every table entry was a NOT_ASSESSED MD-B01 required rule as intended.
method_applied.conservatism: Ambiguous rules left in place. Leaving a rule with its semantic-lock stage is recoverable; moving it wrongly is not. 15 of 170 moved, 155 stayed.
method_applied.supporting_stage_retained: Every moved rule keeps MD-B01 in supporting_stages, because MD-B01 retains a semantic-lock interest in a boundary it defined even when another stage proves it.

MD-B17.basis: consumer read-path enforcement: sealed/current/readable only, publication context required, no raw-table read, no MAX(date), no indicator recomputation, no coverage-gate bypass. MD-B01 can lock these semantics but cannot execute a read path.

MD-B19.basis: retention and maintenance policy: long-term records exempt from ordinary TTL, minimum audit-evidence retention, partitioning by trade date.

MD-B10.basis: publication immutability and the correction/reseal/supersession trail.

MD-B15.basis: 98% minimum delivery-coverage prerequisite for requested-date readability.

coverage_effect.note: Rules moved between stages; none created or destroyed. Global satisfied unchanged at 21.

satisfied_state_revalidation.rule: Traceability standard section 5: a prior SATISFIED carries forward only with demonstrably equivalent predicate identity and evidence that still proves that exact predicate.
satisfied_state_revalidation.basis: No SATISFIED row was moved. The applier refuses SATISFIED rows structurally, and zero refusals occurred, so none was even a candidate. Predicate identity, owning stage, and evidence binding are unchanged for all 21.

source_traceability_preserved.verification: sha1(rule_text) equals rule_fingerprint_sha1 on all 6490 rows, 0 mismatches; documentation gate TRACEABILITY_MATRIX check passes with 0 errors.

scope_not_taken.other_stages: The other 17 stages' assignments were not individually re-derived. For single-purpose owner contracts the document-derived assignment is already correct by construction; that was reasoned, not measured per rule, and is recorded as such rather than claimed as verified.
scope_not_taken.consequence: MD-DEP-0004 does not close. Its remaining scope is restructured into per-stage ownership validation performed when each stage opens, which is where the judgement can be made against that stage's own contract area.

residue_verdict.basis: Ownership-only change to a MUTABLE_TRACEABLE governed artifact. No strategy byte, no runtime code, no schema, no test, no deployed database, no storage artifact, and no immutable record altered.
residue_verdict.residual_risk: Under-correction rather than over-correction: rules that arguably belong downstream were left with MD-B01 where the case was not clear-cut.
